results.title: THE POETICS OF STONES
results.overview: Under a bleak theocratic regime, parents brutally sacrifice their dancer daughter—a crime that turns their heads to stone, while awakening the girl for a surreal, mythic rebirth from the heart of the stones.

results.title: Hip Hop Mediterraneo
results.overview: "Hip Hop Mediterraneo" follows Social Waste, an independent music collective that has been carving its own path outside the conventions of the music industry for 25 years. Its members, scattered across different parts of Greece, reunite to create their new album and hit the road once again. Through personal moments, conflicts and archival material, the film reveals both the strength and the difficulties of collectivity. With sharp political and social commentary, Social Waste merges hip hop with the musical traditions of the Mediterranean. A musical road movie about co-existence, freedom and the power of togetherness.

results.title: Sweet Vampire
results.overview: Santiago goes out for the first time after a messy breakup and meets Marcelo, who awakens long-hidden desires, but their encounter spirals out of control following an attack by a mysterious creature.

results.title: Dollhouse
results.overview: A statuesque starlet meets with the headshot photographer she found in a newspaper listing.

results.title: One Night At Slumber Mansion
results.overview: Morgan is so happy when Elaine is happy, nobody better get in the way of that...

results.title: When Things Move
results.overview: During moving day, Joaquina and her cousin Leonor turn the chaos of boxes into an adventure. Between games, jealousy, and discoveries, the girls explore the corners of a house that seems to hold a secret of its own.

results.title: Fireflies in the Dark
results.overview: Set amidst the ethnic violence that erupted in 2023 in Manipur, Northeast India, Fireflies in the Dark explores survival, resilience, and the human cost of civil conflict. Three interwoven stories craft distinct but connected portraits of lives caught in the strife: a pregnant woman struggles to give birth as gunfire surrounds her; a young boy searches for his mother with only a displaced stray calf for companionship; and a cafe owner risks her safety to shelter those fleeing for their lives.

results.title: Rio Window
results.overview: Rio Window tells the story of a Brazilian heroine: an 80-year-old Black woman who refused to accept the reality unfolding outside her apartment window in Copacabana. In 2003, she bought a camera to record and expose the activities of organized crime and police corruption. The videotapes reached reporter Fábio Gusmão, who helped Dona Vitória enter the witness protection program and trigger an investigation that led to the arrest of 48 criminals, including nine police officers. Her real name and face were kept secret for 17 years.

results.title: Squel, Confessions of the Carnival Queen
results.overview: After retiring in 2022, Squel Jorgea decided to return to Rio’s Carnival. A flag-bearer for over twenty years, she began her career at Grande Rio, where she danced for eleven seasons and became the first to represent both Mangueira and Portela, the two most traditional samba schools. After navigating single motherhood, she has rediscovered the physicality, movement, and strength that established her as a leading figure in the art form; she now dances a theme inspired by the book "Um Defeito de Cor", a son’s letter to his enslaved mother, a narrative that deeply resonates with her own life story. Between the silence and the beat of the drums, her dance transforms into a ritual, an act of resistance, and a celebration of Afro-Brazilian culture.

results.title: The Gesture Between Us
results.overview: Since founding the physical theatre company Dos à Deux, Artur and André have made the camera their constant companion, documenting their lives, their travels around the world, and their creative processes. Over 28 years of rehearsals and touring, the award-winning artistic couple has built an intimate archive in which art and love intertwine both on and off the stage. It is from this unique body of material that the documentary emerges.

results.title: Dead on Arrival
results.overview: When a simple cash drop goes wrong, two sleazy criminals are driven down a path of mystery, violence and betrayal.

results.title: Vessel
results.overview: Potter Rick Rudd curates and protects the nation's fragile crafted legacies within the walls of Quartz Museum of Studio Ceramics. The film follows the construction of one of Rick's latest works in intimate detail, silently capturing his hands forming the clay into another masterpiece. Rick reaches out for help to realise his vision and find release from the daily challenges of single-handedly running a world-class museum.

results.title: Letters from Tibet
results.overview: Letters from Tibet follows an exchange across time between a British colonial officer and a contemporary archivist. Tracing how Tibet has been framed through colonial correspondence, photography, and cinema.

results.title: The Extraordinary Life of Vera Valdez
results.original_title: A Extraordinária Vida de Vera Valdez
results.overview: A portrait of Brazilian actress Vera Valdez, tracing her years as a model for Dior and, most notably, Coco Chanel; her flirtation with the French New Wave; her complex journey through motherhood; and her imprisonment and torture during Brazil’s military dictatorship.

results.title: Pozos
results.overview: A former combatant of the Malvinas war reviews historical events of his life while Alzheimer's progresses little by little inside of him.
